Know the freight market before it moves.

CargoX is an AI co-pilot for Indian charterers. It forecasts freight rates 30–90 days ahead, matches vessels to ports that will physically accept them, reads live weather, AIS congestion and maritime news — then answers the only question that matters: book LTC, ride the spot, or wait?

The idea · simply

A weather forecast… for shipping prices

🌦️

A weather app

watches the sky and tells you “carry an umbrella on Thursday.” You never guess the rain.

➜
🚢

CargoX

watches freight markets, ports, weather & news and tells a charterer “book the ship on the 14th — rates spike on the 20th.”

Shipping costs jump 30–50% in a month, the wrong ship gets sent to the wrong port, and cargo sits idle burning ₹18–44 lakh a day. Today, 70% of these calls are gut feel. CargoX replaces the guess with a forecast, a feasibility check and one clear recommendation.

STEP 1 · 30 SECONDS

User gives input 🧑‍💼

Origin & destination (Mumbai → Dubai), date of shipment, cargo tonnage (10,000 MT). A simple form — no training needed.

STEP 2 · SECONDS, IN BACKGROUND

System processes automatically ⚙️

Past freight trends, port draft/LOA suitability, live AIS congestion, marine weather and 8 news wires — all checked with zero manual work.

STEP 3 · ALL VISUAL & ACTIONABLE

User gets 5 smart outputs 📊

Rate forecast, 3D route map, weather & risk alerts, a LTC/Spot/Wait decision with confidence, and a full cost-savings report.

The big question it answers

LTC · Spot · or Wait?

🟢

LOCK LTC

Rates are rising? Cover multiple voyages with a long-term contract while the curve is still flat.

🟡

RIDE THE SPOT

Market dipping? Book spot, optimise bunkering, and catch the low — with the savings % shown upfront.

🔴

WAIT

A price dip is forecast? Hold 6 days, then fix — the agent even writes the one-line booking call.

Why it's different

A decision engine, not another dashboard

  • Predicts rate spikes precisely — Prophet trend + XGBoost cost + news-sentiment delta.
  • Prevents dock rejections — draft / LOA / tonnage hard-rules filter vessels before booking.
  • 3D-tracks live coordinates — AIS vessels moving on a WebGL globe, congestion columns per berth.
  • Market news agent — an LLM reads 8 maritime wires and re-prices the forecast the morning news breaks.
  • Works without Wi-Fi — local-first SQLite + models on localhost; cached AIS replays offline.
  • Maximises cargo tonnage — right vessel class for the right port, every time.
The problem

India trades by sea. India guesses by gut.

Indian maritime logistics suffers from volatile freight rates, inefficient vessel-port matching causing rejections & delays, and zero predictive decision support for charterers.

±38%

Rate volatility

Weekly swing in Supramax spot rates; 30–50% inside 30 days. Charterers book blind and lose crores in the spot market.

₹44 lakh

Port mismatch

A Capesize (180K DWT, 18 m draft) sent to Haldia (8 m draft) is rejected on arrival — ₹44 lakh lost per incident.

₹2.2 Cr

Operational blindness

No AIS congestion + weather view → vessels idle 2–5 days at anchorage. Demurrage runs ₹18–44 lakh per day.

70%

Decision gap

Of LTC-vs-Spot-vs-Wait calls are made on gut feel. No tool combines forecast + feasibility + risk. Manual quote checks take 40 min per charter.

National importance

Why India needs this NOW

  • 95% of trade by volume, 70% by value moves via sea — the lifeline of the economy.
  • Logistics cost = 13–14% of GDP vs 8% global average → ₹17.6 lakh crore excess cost every year.
  • Indian steel & heavy industry rely on imported raw materials — wrong guesses lose thousands of crore rupees yearly.
  • Sagarmala: ₹10.6 lakh crore across 600+ port projects needs smart optimisation across 12 major + 200 minor ports.
  • PM Gati Shakti: cut logistics cost from 13–14% → 8% of GDP. CargoX is software on that exact mission.
  • Atmanirbhar Bharat: an indigenous AI tool reduces dependence on foreign brokers and paywalled data.

Architecture · module by module

One pipeline, four data sources, two star modules

🌍 LIVE 3D GLOBE NEW

pyDeck GlobeLayer fed by AISstream WebSockets at 1 s cadence — drag to spin, click any hull to pull its AIS block (speed, heading, draft, next port, ETA). Port congestion columns measure anchorage dwell from live AIS, not last month's report. A red berth means a Capesize physically cannot enter.

📰 AI NEWS AGENT NEW

Ingest → Score → Price-in → Act. Eight RSS/API wires on a 30 s cadence, sentiment-tagged bullish/bearish, the delta applied to the Prophet curve, XGBoost re-runs, and the agent writes a one-line booking call with a confidence band. Learned deltas: canal reroute +4.1%, ore season +2.6%, newbuildings −2.2%.

Failsafes

What can go wrong on demo day — already solved

RiskMitigationStatus
Venue Wi-Fi dies mid-demoLocal-first: Streamlit + Python models + SQLite on localhost; globe & agent replay cached AIS / headline packets.SOLVED
Maritime data is paywalledAISstream free WebSocket tier + Open-Meteo + public RSS + Baltic Exchange public data. Zero-cost prototype.SOLVED
Missing / noisy telemetryNormalization layer, null handling, fallback to 30-day historical average.SOLVED
Unsafe vessel–port pairingDraft / LOA / tonnage hard-rule filter with a pre-validated Indian port database (Haldia 8 m, Mumbai 12 m…).SOLVED
Model drift after a shockNews-agent delta re-weights the trend hourly; every alert stores its own confidence band.SOLVED

Research & data sources

Baltic Exchange — Baltic Dry Index, primary benchmark for dry-bulk rates; training history for Prophet.
AISstream.io — real-time vessel positions, congestion detection, port traffic density.
Open-Meteo — wave height, wind and storm warnings for delay-risk scoring.
